query.default: SELECT board.name as BoardName, board.id as BoardId, ticket.columnname as ColumnName, ticket.name as TicketName, ticket.id as TicketId, recipient.name as Performer, ticket.laboriousness as Workload, ticket.completedate as CompletedDate, ticket.uid as Uid, columns.indexcolumn as IndexColumn FROM dirrx_kanban1_ticket ticket LEFT JOIN dirrx_kanban1_ticketperforme ticketperformer ON ticketperformer.ticket = ticket.id LEFT JOIN sungero_core_recipient recipient ON recipient.id = ticketperformer.performer LEFT JOIN dirrx_kanban1_column col ON ticket.columnid = col.id LEFT JOIN dirrx_kanban1_boardcolumns columns ON col.id = columns.column LEFT JOIN dirrx_kanban1_board board ON board.id = ticket.boardid WHERE board.project = @ProjectId AND ticket.status = 'Closed' AND ticket.completedate <= @CurrentDate AND ticket.completedate >= @StartDate

SELECT board.name as BoardName, board.id as BoardId, ticket.columnname as ColumnName, ticket.name as TicketName, ticket.id as TicketId, recipient.name as Performer, ticket.laboriousness as Workload, ticket.completedate as CompletedDate, ticket.uid as Uid, columns.indexcolumn as IndexColumn FROM dirrx_kanban1_ticket ticket LEFT JOIN dirrx_kanban1_ticketperforme ticketperformer ON ticketperformer.ticket = ticket.id LEFT JOIN sungero_core_recipient recipient ON recipient.id = ticketperformer.performer LEFT JOIN dirrx_kanban1_column col ON ticket.columnid = col.id LEFT JOIN dirrx_kanban1_boardcolumns columns ON col.id = columns.column LEFT JOIN dirrx_kanban1_board board ON board.id = columns.board WHERE board.project = @ProjectId AND ticket.status != 'Deleted' AND columns.indexcolumn != 0 AND col.isfinal != true
